text.tspan: Confidence in the effectiveness of vaccines vs. perception of importance
Share of respondents who agree with the statement "vaccines are effective" versus the share of respondents
who agree with the statement "vaccines are important for children to have".

tspan.tspan: Where data for 2025 is unavailable, the value from the closest year between 2020 and 2024 is shown instead.
